_comment: Rule-liveness ratchet baseline (tools/raman_saab/rule_liveness.py over the golden corpus). never_fired / yogas_never are the counts that MUST NOT INCREASE. Adding a rule no golden exercises, or breaking one so it stops firing, raises the count and fails test_rule_liveness. Fixing/covering rules lowers it -> re-baseline down. Re-based after the +25 NH Track-B charts (corpus 192->217): never_fired 88->84. Re-based 2026-08-08 (CONSCIOUS, same-commit as the first 3HC tranche): +5 yogas encoded from the clean copies (registry 72->77); Y.BRAHMA and Y.NISHTURABHASHI fire on goldens, while Y.GAURI/Y.MATSYA/Y.RAVI are genuinely rare multi-clause patterns no golden holds — each has a synthetic positive test proving the mechanism CAN fire (test_yogas.py), which is the distinction this ratchet exists to force. yogas_never 23->26, yogas_total 72->77, yogas_fired 49->51. Re-based 2026-08-09 (CONSCIOUS, tranche 2): +7 yogas (77->84); SIX fire on goldens including Y.LAKSHMI (measured out of its deferral at 12/225 gated); only Y.ANDHA never fires — a congenital-blindness pattern no worked nativity of Raman's holds, with a synthetic proof for both printed forms. yogas_fired 51->57, yogas_never 26->27. Re-based 2026-08-09 (CONSCIOUS, tranche 4): +6 yogas (91->97), the 3rd/4th-house block from the complete edition; FIVE fire on goldens (Ekabhagini 1, Parakrama 38, Satkathadisravana 27, Uttama Griha 59, Vichitra Saudha 1); only Y.DWADASA_SAHODARA never fires — it needs EXALTED Mars conjunct Jupiter in a trikona from a kendra-placed 3rd lord, and Raman's own remark on combo 180 says the yoga 'is typical inasmuch as it is rare'; fire/silent synthetics prove the mechanism. yogas_fired 61->66, yogas_never 30->31. Re-based 2026-08-09 (CONSCIOUS, tranche 5): +8 records covering combos 189-210's mechanical dozen (91-97->105); ALL EIGHT fire on goldens (Bandhu Pujya-194 on 130/225 — Raman's own remark calls it 'more general and broad-based'; Bandhu Pujya-193 on 3; Vahana 68, Kapata 44, Matrugami 36, Ayatna Griha 25, Grihanasa 21, Matru Satrutwa 15). yogas_never UNCHANGED at 31 — no new never-firing yoga this tranche. yogas_fired 66->74. Re-based 2026-08-09 (CONSCIOUS, tranche 6): +5 records clearing the queued bars (105->110); ALL FIVE fire on goldens, including the STRENGTH-GATED pair on real Shadbala (Matrudeerghayur 12/225, Anapathya 5/225 — the B1 gates select, they do not kill); Matrunasa 178, Matru Sneha 197 and Nishkapata 155 are broad AS PRINTED (Raman's own remarks call 205 'very flexible' and 194's family 'general'). yogas_never STILL 31, fired 74->79. Nishkapata-206 deferred on the ladder-identity question (GBB Parvathamsa=3 vs BPHS Uttama=3/Paravata=6), recorded in the registry.
